sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持服务的电话号码建议，请查看您应用中本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: In early 1998, three Finnish tourists were sound asleep at the Cedar Lodge Hotel, near California's Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 1998年初，三名芬兰游客在靠近加州优胜美地国家公园的雪松旅馆熟睡。

sentences.en: The trio consisted of two young girls and an older woman who was acting as their guardian.
sentences.zh: 这三人包括两名年轻女孩和一名担任她们监护人的年长女性。

sentences.en: At around 2am, they woke to the sound of something rattling.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点左右，她们被一阵嘎吱声惊醒。

sentences.en: It wasn't particularly loud, but the hotel's remote setting, surrounded by acres of woodland, meant that even quiet noises could cut through the silence like a buzzsaw.
sentences.zh: 声音并不算大，但由于旅馆地处偏远，四周环绕着大片林地，即使是轻微的响动也能像电锯一样划破寂静。

sentences.en: Like all of the rooms at the Cedar Lodge, the women's room opened to an outdoor parking lot that any passerby could pull into.
sentences.zh: 和雪松旅馆的所有房间一样，她们的房间正对着一个室外停车场，任何路人都可以开车进来。

sentences.en: They quickly realised that the rattling was coming from the front door of their room, just a few feet away.
sentences.zh: 她们很快意识到，嘎吱声来自几英尺外房间的前门。

sentences.en: Someone was fiddling with the handle from the outside, trying to get in.
sentences.zh: 有人在外面摆弄门把手，试图闯入。

sentences.en: The women had locked the door earlier, but this wasn't deterring the person on the other side.
sentences.zh: 她们之前已经锁好了门，但这并没有阻挡门外的人。

sentences.en: It sounded as though they were trying to gain access with a key, as opposed to using a tool or brute force.
sentences.zh: 听起来对方似乎是在试图用钥匙开门，而不是使用工具或暴力强行破门。

sentences.en: The older woman cried out in panic before calling the front desk.
sentences.zh: 年长的女性惊恐地尖叫起来，随后拨打了前台电话。

sentences.en: She informed hotel staff that someone was breaking into their room.
sentences.zh: 她告知旅馆工作人员有人正在闯入她们的房间。

sentences.en: But by this point, the rattling had stopped.
sentences.zh: 但此时，嘎吱声已经停止了。

sentences.en: If someone had indeed tried to break in, they were gone by the time security was notified.
sentences.zh: 如果确实有人试图闯入，那么在保安接到通知时，他们已经离开了。

sentences.en: No one was found loitering in the area, nor seen sprinting away.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现徘徊的人，也没有人看到有人飞奔逃离。

sentences.en: The hotel's maintenance man checked the door.
sentences.zh: 旅馆的维修工检查了房门。

sentences.en: The lock appeared untouched and was still fully functional, which put the women at ease.
sentences.zh: 门锁看起来完好无损，功能正常，这让她们放下心来。

sentences.en: Their night continued without any further interruptions, and no other suspected break-ins were reported.
sentences.zh: 那一晚她们再未受到打扰，也没有其他疑似闯入的报告。

sentences.en: In December 1998, Silvina Peloso left her home city of Cordoba, Argentina, bound for the United States.
sentences.zh: 1998年12月，西尔维娜·佩洛索离开家乡阿根廷科尔多瓦，前往美国。

sentences.en: The 16-year-old had inherited her mother's spirit for travel and had signed up to be a foreign exchange student.
sentences.zh: 这位16岁的少女继承了母亲热爱旅行的精神，报名参加了外国交换生项目。

sentences.en: For the next three months, Silvina would be living with the six-member Sund family in the northern Californian port city of Eureka.
sentences.zh: 接下来的三个月里，西尔维娜将与六口之家的桑德一家住在加州北部的港口城市尤里卡。

sentences.en: The Pelosos and sons were long-time friends through mothers Raquel and Carol.
sentences.zh: 佩洛索一家和桑德一家通过两位母亲——拉奎尔和卡罗尔——结下了长久的友谊。

sentences.en: The two women met in the 70s, when Carol travelled to Argentina as an exchange student herself.
sentences.zh: 这两位女性相识于70年代，当时卡罗尔自己也曾作为交换生前往阿根廷。

sentences.en: Carol revisited the country years later with her two-year-old daughter,
sentences.zh: 多年后，卡罗尔带着她两岁的女儿重访了那个国家，

sentences.en: Juliana, better known as Julie.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩叫朱莉安娜，也就是大家熟知的朱莉。

sentences.en: By this stage, the Pelosos had two daughters, with Silvina the younger of the pair.
sentences.zh: 当时，佩洛索家有两个女儿，西尔维娜是较小的那个。

sentences.en: She and Julie Sund were similar in age, but opposites in personality.
sentences.zh: 她和朱莉·桑德年龄相仿，但性格迥异。

sentences.en: Silvina was an introvert, unlike Julie, who was more outgoing.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娜性格内向，而朱莉则更加外向。

sentences.en: Despite their differences, the girls formed a lifelong friendship of their own.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在差异，两个女孩还是建立起了终身的友谊。

sentences.en: Silvina was due to return home from the US in late March 1999.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娜原定于1999年3月下旬从美国返回家乡。

sentences.en: As she was very interested in American culture, the sons had endeavoured to give her a memorable experience of their homeland.
sentences.zh: 由于她对美国文化非常感兴趣，桑德一家努力想让她在家乡留下难忘的体验。

sentences.en: They had taken Silvina all across the state to visit landmarks such as Disneyland and Fisherman's Wharf.
sentences.zh: 他们带着西尔维娜游遍了全州，参观了迪士尼乐园和渔人码头等标志性景点。

sentences.en: The Grand Canyon in Arizona was next on their list, as was Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的大峡谷和优胜美地国家公园也在他们的计划清单上。

sentences.en: It took Carol Sund a month to meticulously plan the perfect road trip to Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔·桑德花了一个月的时间精心规划了这次前往优胜美地的完美公路旅行。

sentences.en: Carol's schedule was typically full with family, work, and other commitments, so she made the most out of every minute of her vacations.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的日程通常被家庭、工作和其他事务排得满满当当，所以她充分利用了假期的每一分钟。

sentences.en: The Yosemite trip revolved around one of Julie's cheerleading competitions and would be taking place over four days that encompassed a long weekend.
sentences.zh: 这次优胜美地之行围绕朱莉的一场啦啦队比赛展开，为期四天，横跨一个长周末。

sentences.en: Only Carol, Julie, and Silvina would be going.
sentences.zh: 只有卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜三人前往。

sentences.en: It was set to be a unique adventure, as winter had brought snow to the region.
sentences.zh: 这将是一次独特的冒险，因为冬季给该地区带来了积雪。

sentences.en: The trip began on Friday, February 12.
sentences.zh: 行程于2月12日星期五开始。

sentences.en: Carol, Julie, and Silvina flew to San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜飞往旧金山。

sentences.en: From there, they hired a car and drove two hours northeast to Stockton.
sentences.zh: 从那里，她们租了一辆车，向东北方向行驶了两个小时到达斯托克顿。

sentences.en: The city was home to the University of the Pacific, where Julie's cheerleading competition took place on Saturday, February 13.
sentences.zh: 这座城市是太平洋大学的所在地，朱莉的啦啦队比赛于2月13日星期六在那里举行。

sentences.en: Julie was impressed by the campus and considered enrolling there after graduating high school.
sentences.zh: 朱莉对校园印象深刻，并考虑高中毕业后申请入读。

sentences.en: She had ambitions to become either a chef or an architect, while maintaining her passion for violin and piano.
sentences.zh: 她立志成为一名厨师或建筑师，同时保持着对小提琴和钢琴的热爱。

sentences.en: Julie, Carol, and Silvina organised to return to the university for a proper tour in three days' time.
sentences.zh: 朱莉、卡罗尔和西尔维娜计划在三天后回到大学进行正式参观。

sentences.en: From Stockton, the trio drove to the small farming town of Merced, known as the Gateway to Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 从斯托克顿出发，三人驱车前往被称为“优胜美地门户”的小农镇默塞德。

sentences.en: They spent the night at the Ramada Inn before continuing on to Yosemite National Park on the Sunday.
sentences.zh: 她们在华美达酒店住了一晚，随后于周日继续前往优胜美地国家公园。

sentences.en: Silvina was particularly excited to see Yosemite's granite cliffs, waterfalls, lakes, meadows, and mountains.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娜对看到优胜美地的花岗岩悬崖、瀑布、湖泊、草甸和山脉感到格外兴奋。

sentences.en: She was an active person by nature, who enjoyed ice skating, skiing, and roller skating.
sentences.zh: 她天生好动，喜欢滑冰、滑雪和轮滑。

sentences.en: She also loved the outdoors and hoped to study an environmental field in the future.
sentences.zh: 她还热爱户外活动，希望未来能从事环境领域的研究。

sentences.en: Carol, Julie, and Silvina spent their first day at Yosemite exploring part of the park's 750,000 acres of rugged wilderness.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜在优胜美地的第一天，探索了公园75万英亩崎岖荒野的一部分。

sentences.en: Before day's end, they drove through the dense and far-reaching forests along Highway 140 to the nearby town of El Portal.
sentences.zh: 天黑前，她们沿着140号公路穿过茂密而广袤的森林，前往附近的埃尔波塔尔镇。

sentences.en: There, they checked in at the Cedar Lodge, an affordable hotel on the banks of the Merced River.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她们入住了位于默塞德河畔的经济型酒店——雪松旅馆。

sentences.en: On the evening of Monday February 15, Yen's son received a phone call from his wife, Carol.
sentences.zh: 2月15日星期一晚上，延斯的儿子接到了妻子卡罗尔的电话。

sentences.en: She happily spoke of her time away with the Julie and Silvina in Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 她开心地谈论着在优胜美地与朱莉和西尔维娜共度的时光。

sentences.en: They had spent the previous two days exploring the park and were settling in for their final night at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 她们前两天一直在探索公园，正准备在旅馆度过最后一晚。

sentences.en: Yens planned to meet the three women at San Francisco International Airport the next day.
sentences.zh: 延斯计划第二天在旧金山国际机场迎接这三位女性。

sentences.en: Carol and Julie would return home to Eureka, while Silvina would join Yens and the other three sonned children on a flight to Phoenix, Arizona to visit the Grand Canyon.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔和朱莉将返回尤里卡的家中，而西尔维娜将与延斯及其他三个孩子一起飞往亚利桑那州的凤凰城参观大峡谷。

sentences.en: Yens and his children flew in to San Francisco at 10.45pm on Tuesday February 16.
sentences.zh: 延斯和他的孩子们于2月16日星期二晚上10点45分飞抵旧金山。

sentences.en: A storm had delayed their flight by five hours.
sentences.zh: 一场风暴导致他们的航班延误了五个小时。

sentences.en: There was no way to notify Carol as she didn't have a mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 由于卡罗尔没有手机，无法通知她。

sentences.en: Instead, Yens paged his wife over the airport's loudspeaker, but there was no sign of her, Julie or Silvina.
sentences.zh: 延斯在机场通过广播呼叫妻子，但没有她、朱莉或西尔维娜的踪影。

sentences.en: The connecting flight to Phoenix was departing immediately.
sentences.zh: 前往凤凰城的转机航班即将起飞。

sentences.en: Yens faced a snap decision, board without Silvina or wait and miss the flight.
sentences.zh: 延斯面临一个仓促的决定：要么不带西尔维娜登机，要么等待并错过航班。

sentences.en: He decided to leave without her.
sentences.zh: 他决定不等她直接离开。

sentences.en: His wife was very resourceful and fully capable of booking Silvina on another flight.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子足智多谋，完全有能力为西尔维娜预订另一趟航班。

sentences.en: Yens awoke in Arizona the next morning and played a round of golf.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，延斯在亚利桑那州醒来，打了一场高尔夫球。

sentences.en: He wasn't concerned about Carol, Julie or Silvina until midday came and he still hadn't heard from them.
sentences.zh: 直到中午仍未收到卡罗尔、朱莉或西尔维娜的消息，他才开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Worried that they might have been in a car accident, he contacted the California Highway Patrol, but no incidents had been reported.
sentences.zh: 担心她们可能遭遇车祸，他联系了加州公路巡警，但没有收到任何事故报告。

sentences.en: Yens then called the Cedar Lodge in El Portal.
sentences.zh: 随后，延斯致电埃尔波塔尔的雪松旅馆。

sentences.en: He was informed that his wife and the girls had seemingly left the day before as planned.
sentences.zh: 他被告知，他的妻子和女孩们似乎已按计划于前一天离开。

sentences.en: The lodge had Carol's credit card details on file, which meant she didn't need to physically check out at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 旅馆留有卡罗尔的信用卡信息，这意味着她无需在前台办理退房手续。

sentences.en: She simply left the hotel keys in her room and her card was charged accordingly.
sentences.zh: 她只需将房门钥匙留在房间里，旅馆便会相应地扣除费用。

sentences.en: Yens contacted the rental car company that Carol had used.
sentences.zh: 延斯联系了卡罗尔租车的公司。

sentences.en: She was supposed to drop the vehicle off in Modesto before her flight to San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 她本应在飞往旧金山之前在莫德斯托还车。

sentences.en: The car hadn't yet been returned.
sentences.zh: 但车还没有归还。

sentences.en: It was out of character for Carol not to follow through with plans.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔不按计划行事是不符合她性格的。

sentences.en: The 42-year-old was diligent and reliable.
sentences.zh: 这位42岁的女性一向勤奋可靠。

sentences.en: As a mother of four and co-owner of a real estate company, she had to be.
sentences.zh: 作为四个孩子的母亲和一家房地产公司的共同所有人，她必须如此。

sentences.en: Carol also worked in the local courts as an advocate for abused children, volunteered as a parenting teacher, and pursued other business interests.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔还在当地法院担任受虐儿童的辩护人，志愿担任育儿教师，并追求其他商业利益。

sentences.en: She was known for her charity work, including a non-profit she co-founded that provided care and shelter for the mentally disabled.
sentences.zh: 她以慈善工作闻名，包括与人共同创立了一家为智障人士提供护理和住所的非营利组织。

sentences.en: The Sons notified the Sheriff's Department in Yosemite of the trio's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 桑德一家向优胜美地警长办公室报告了三人的失踪。

sentences.en: It was initially thought that Carol and the teens were lost or had skidded off the road.
sentences.zh: 起初，人们认为卡罗尔和孩子们可能迷路了，或者车滑出了公路。

sentences.en: A large-scale, multi-agency search commenced.
sentences.zh: 一场大规模的多机构搜救行动随即展开。

sentences.en: Police officers and park rangers were on the lookout for Carol's rental car, a bright red 1998 Pontiac Grand Prix with Californian license plates.
sentences.zh: 警察和公园巡逻员都在寻找卡罗尔的租用车——一辆挂着加州车牌的亮红色1998年款庞蒂亚克大奖赛轿车。

sentences.en: Highway Patrol drove down Highway 120, which runs through Yosemite, as well as Highway 140, which connects the Cedar Lodge with the park.
sentences.zh: 公路巡警沿着穿过优胜美地的120号公路以及连接雪松旅馆与公园的140号公路进行了搜寻。

sentences.en: There was no evidence of a vehicular accident or mishap anywhere.
sentences.zh: 但到处都没有发现车祸或意外的迹象。

sentences.en: Records from the Cedar Lodge confirmed the women had checked in on the afternoon of Sunday February 14.
sentences.zh: 雪松旅馆的记录证实，她们于2月14日星期日下午办理了入住。

sentences.en: The lodge was at capacity due to it being both Valentine's Day and the President's Day long weekend.
sentences.zh: 由于当天既是情人节又是总统日长周末，旅馆客满。

sentences.en: They were assigned to room 509, a twin bedroom away from the central reception area and car park.
sentences.zh: 她们被分配到509号房，这是一个远离中央接待区和停车场的双人卧室。

sentences.en: By Monday afternoon, most of the hotel guests had checked out.
sentences.zh: 到周一下午，大多数房客都已经退房。

sentences.en: Carol, Julie and Sylvina were the only ones remaining in their block.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜是她们那一区仅剩的住客。

sentences.en: They rented some movies from the front desk, and that evening, Julie and Sylvina ate at the hotel's restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她们在前台租了几部电影，那天晚上，朱莉和西尔维娜在旅馆餐厅用餐。

sentences.en: The pair were halfway through their dinner when Carol arrived to pay the bill at 6.32pm.
sentences.zh: 两人吃到一半时，卡罗尔在下午6点32分赶来结账。

sentences.en: Julie and Sylvina left with Carol, telling their server they would be back to finish their half-eaten burgers.
sentences.zh: 朱莉和西尔维娜随卡罗尔离开，告诉服务员她们会回来吃完剩下的汉堡。

sentences.en: But they never returned.
sentences.zh: 但她们再也没有回来。

sentences.en: Room 509 hadn't been touched since Carol and the teens had left.
sentences.zh: 自卡罗尔和孩子们离开后，509号房就再没被动过。

sentences.en: Police searched the room and found the rented movies on a table, along with a paper bag containing souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了房间，在桌上发现了租来的电影，还有一个装有纪念品的纸袋。

sentences.en: There were also wet towels on the bathroom floor, and an apple and a bottle of tomato juice in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 浴室地板上有湿毛巾，冰箱里还有一个苹果和一瓶番茄汁。

sentences.en: The group's luggage was gone, and their room key had been left behind, as per the hotel's checkout policy.
sentences.zh: 她们的行李不见了，房门钥匙按照旅馆的退房政策留在了房间里。

sentences.en: Police contacted the University of the Pacific in Stockton.
sentences.zh: 警方联系了位于斯托克顿的太平洋大学。

sentences.en: The trio had scheduled to tour the campus hours before their flight back to San Francisco on the 16th.
sentences.zh: 三人原定在16日飞回旧金山前几个小时参观校园。

sentences.en: But they didn't show up.
sentences.zh: 但她们没有出现。

sentences.en: Their absence wasn't reported, as it was assumed they had simply made other plans.
sentences.zh: 她们的缺席并未引起注意，因为人们以为她们只是另有安排。

sentences.en: 30 miles south-east of Stockton is the inland city of Modesto, the final destination on Carol, Julie and Sylvina's road trip.
sentences.zh: 斯托克顿东南30英里处是内陆城市莫德斯托，这是卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜公路旅行的终点站。

sentences.en: On Friday February 19, a teen was walking to school in Modesto's northern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 2月19日星期五，一名少女在莫德斯托北郊步行上学。

sentences.en: Near the intersection of main thoroughfares Brigsmore Avenue and Tully Road, she spotted the insert of a wallet containing several cards.
sentences.zh: 在布里格斯莫尔大道和塔利路这两条主干道的交叉口附近，她发现了一个钱包内衬，里面装着几张卡片。

sentences.en: Inside were Carol Sunds' driver's license and credit cards, confirming had belonged to her.
sentences.zh: 里面有卡罗尔·桑德的驾照和信用卡，证实钱包属于她。

sentences.en: It was unclear whether the wallet insert had been lost, abandoned, or stolen.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚这个钱包内衬是丢失、被遗弃还是被盗。

sentences.en: That same day, a call came through to the Wells Fargo Bank helpline from someone claiming to be Carol Sund.
sentences.zh: 同一天，富国银行热线接到一个自称是卡罗尔·桑德的人打来的电话。

sentences.en: This person requested a duplicate ATM card be sent to her.
sentences.zh: 此人要求补办一张ATM卡寄给她。

sentences.en: But she was unable to provide proof of identity, so the call was terminated.
sentences.zh: 但由于她无法提供身份证明，通话被终止了。

sentences.en: Two days later, the person claiming to be Carol called the helpline again, wanting to know her bank balance.
sentences.zh: 两天后，那个自称卡罗尔的人再次拨打热线，询问她的银行余额。

sentences.en: This time, she provided Carol's social security number and was given the information.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她提供了卡罗尔的社会安全号码，并获得了相关信息。

sentences.en: When investigators learnt of the wallet insert and the helpline calls, they suspected Carol had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员得知钱包内衬和热线电话的事后，他们怀疑卡罗尔遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: It seemed likely that the caller seeking her ATM card and banking details was an imposter.
sentences.zh: 那个索要ATM卡和银行详细信息的人很可能是一个冒充者。

sentences.en: Wells Fargo provided details of the 800,000 calls made to their helpline between February 19 and 21.
sentences.zh: 富国银行提供了2月19日至21日期间拨打其热线的80万个电话的详细信息。

sentences.en: Investigators whittled down the list and looked into over 100 people who might have placed the call.
sentences.zh: 调查人员缩小了名单范围，对100多名可能拨打过电话的人进行了调查。

sentences.en: But their efforts were unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 但他们的努力没有成功。

sentences.en: Bank records revealed that Carol's last purchase were the burgers Julie and Sylvina ordered at the Cedar Lodge restaurant the evening before they vanished.
sentences.zh: 银行记录显示，卡罗尔最后的消费是朱莉和西尔维娜在失踪前一天晚上于雪松旅馆餐厅点的汉堡。

sentences.en: She had also withdrawn $200 from an ATM in Merced before the group arrived at Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 在抵达优胜美地之前，她还在默塞德的一台ATM机上取了200美元。

sentences.en: The cash was missing, but her credit cards hadn't been used, despite some having a $13,000 limit.
sentences.zh: 现金不见了，但她的信用卡一直没有被使用，尽管有些卡的额度高达13000美元。

sentences.en: The families of Carol, Julie and Sylvina descended on Yosemite, seeking answers.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜的家人来到优胜美地，寻求答案。

sentences.en: Six days into the search, a visibly stunned Jens Sund fronted a press conference.
sentences.zh: 搜寻工作进行到第六天，神情恍惚的延斯·桑德出席了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: The National Park was a meaningful place for Jens, as it was where he and Carol had honeymooned.
sentences.zh: 国家公园对延斯来说意义非凡，因为他和卡罗尔曾在这里度蜜月。

sentences.en: He could offer no reason why his family would be targeted in a crime.
sentences.zh: 他无法解释为什么他的家人会成为犯罪目标。

sentences.en: He described his wife and daughter as fighters who wouldn't easily succumb to an assailant.
sentences.zh: 他形容妻子和女儿是坚强的人，不会轻易向袭击者屈服。

sentences.en: The Eureka community was equally shocked.
sentences.zh: 尤里卡社区同样感到震惊。

sentences.en: They couldn't understand how someone as cautious and protective as Carol could end up in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他们无法理解像卡罗尔这样谨慎且有保护意识的人怎么会陷入困境。

sentences.en: Carol had come from the wealthy Carrington family.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔来自富有的卡林顿家族。

sentences.en: Her parents lived on a sprawling ranch north of Eureka, partially funded by their successful real estate business that Carol inherited.
sentences.zh: 她的父母住在尤里卡北部一个广阔的牧场上，资金部分来自卡罗尔继承的成功房地产业务。

sentences.en: She and Jens ran the business side by side.
sentences.zh: 她和延斯并肩经营着这项业务。

sentences.en: The couple were also principals in the Carrington Co., which owned several malls across the country.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇还是卡林顿公司的负责人，该公司在全国拥有多家购物中心。

sentences.en: Yet, the sons didn't indulge a lavish lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 然而，桑德一家并不沉溺于奢华的生活方式。

sentences.en: They lived in a modest, pale green bungalow with their two pet dogs.
sentences.zh: 他们和两只宠物狗住在一栋朴素的浅绿色平房里。

sentences.en: If the perpetrators were targeting the Carrington's wealth, they had yet to make any ransom demands.
sentences.zh: 如果犯罪分子是冲着卡林顿家族的财富而来，他们至今尚未提出任何赎金要求。

sentences.en: Carol's parents put their money to use, offering a $250,000 reward for information, no questions asked.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的父母悬赏25万美元征集线索，承诺对提供信息者不问缘由。

sentences.en: The family also chartered a plane to conduct an aerial search of Yosemite, but nothing of significance was spotted.
sentences.zh: 家人还包了一架飞机对优胜美地进行空中搜寻，但没有发现任何重要线索。

sentences.en: By now, the FBI were involved in the case.
sentences.zh: 此时，联邦调查局已介入此案。

sentences.en: Over two dozen agents had arrived at Yosemite, led by Special Agent James Maddock.
sentences.zh: 在特别探员詹姆斯·马多克的带领下，两打多名探员抵达了优胜美地。

sentences.en: They set up a command post at a nearby hotel.
sentences.zh: 他们在附近的一家旅馆设立了指挥所。

sentences.en: The walls of a conference room were plastered floor to ceiling with a timeline of events.
sentences.zh: 会议室的墙上从地板到天花板贴满了事件的时间线。

sentences.en: It detailed all sightings of the missing women that had come through to a 24-hour case hotline.
sentences.zh: 上面详细记录了所有通过24小时案件热线收到的关于失踪女性的目击报告。

sentences.en: On the final day of their trip, the trio were allegedly spotted in Yosemite Valley, a 30-minute drive east from the Cedar Lodge.
sentences.zh: 据称，在她们旅行的最后一天，这三人曾在优胜美地山谷被看到，那里距离雪松旅馆向东有30分钟的车程。

sentences.en: They reportedly asked for directions to Tuolumne Grove, a riverside meadow just over an hour's drive away.
sentences.zh: 据报道，她们曾询问去图奥勒米草甸的路，那是一个距离此处仅一小时多车程的河畔草甸。

sentences.en: A sporty red vehicle was also seen parked in a Yosemite Valley lot between midday and 2pm that same day.
sentences.zh: 同一天中午到下午2点之间，还有人看到一辆红色的运动型车辆停在优胜美地山谷的一个停车场里。

sentences.en: The possibility that the trio had a car accident once again gained momentum, and further searches of the parkland were carried out.
sentences.zh: 三人遭遇车祸的可能性再次受到关注，公园内也进行了进一步的搜寻。

sentences.en: Recent snowstorms hindered efforts, but within two days, 4,000 miles of roadway had been driven and 50 miles of terrain trudged on foot.
sentences.zh: 近期的暴风雪阻碍了搜救工作，但在两天内，搜救人员驱车行驶了4000英里，并徒步跋涉了50英里的地形。

sentences.en: As planes and helicopters scanned from above, what looked like the burned-out shell of a car was spotted along a back road.
sentences.zh: 当飞机和直升机从空中扫描时，在一条小路旁发现了一个看起来像是烧毁的汽车残骸。

sentences.en: It turned out to be a propane tank.
sentences.zh: 结果发现那是一个丙烷罐。

sentences.en: Special Agent Maddock told reporters,
sentences.zh: 特别探员马多克告诉记者：

sentences.en: The territory here is huge, the territory is rugged, and the search is going to take some time.
sentences.zh: 这里的区域非常广阔，地形崎岖，搜寻工作还需要一些时间。

sentences.en: But if the car is out there, we'll find it.
sentences.zh: 但如果车在那里，我们一定会找到它。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: By Friday February 26, Carol, Julie and Sylvina had been missing for 10 days.
sentences.zh: 到2月26日星期五，卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜已经失踪了10天。

sentences.en: Nine abandoned or stolen cars had been found throughout Yosemite, but none were Carol's missing rental.
sentences.zh: 在整个优胜美地发现了九辆被遗弃或被盗的汽车，但没有一辆是卡罗尔失踪的那辆租用车。

sentences.en: While the likelihood of a car accident no longer seemed likely, it couldn't be ruled out entirely.
sentences.zh: 虽然车祸的可能性看起来不再那么大，但也不能完全排除。

sentences.en: Carol's car might have plunged into a remote canyon and remained hidden by shrubs or snow.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的车可能冲进了一个偏僻的峡谷，并被灌木丛或积雪掩盖了。

sentences.en: Special Agent Maddock urged the public to check their properties and unused barns for the Red Pontiac, advising it may have been salvaged or dismantled.
sentences.zh: 特别探员马多克敦促公众检查他们的房产和闲置的谷仓，寻找那辆红色庞蒂亚克，并建议它可能已经被回收或拆解了。

sentences.en: Carol's parents offered a further $50,000 reward for any information leading to the Pontiac's location.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的父母又悬赏5万美元，征集任何能找到这辆庞蒂亚克下落的线索。

sentences.en: This was distinct from their reward for Carol, Julie and Sylvina's whereabouts, which they bolstered to $300,000.
sentences.zh: 这与他们为卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜的下落提供的悬赏金是分开的，后者已被他们提高到了30万美元。

sentences.en: Alleged sightings continued to come in.
sentences.zh: 关于她们的目击报告仍在不断涌入。

sentences.en: A Best Western Hotel clerk in Oakland believed the three women had approached the desk inquiring about room rates.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰一家最佳西方酒店的职员认为，这三名女性曾来到前台询问房价。

sentences.en: Another person reported seeing them at a roadside fruit stand in Escalon.
sentences.zh: 另一个人报告说在埃斯卡隆的一个路边水果摊看到了她们。

sentences.en: Both locations were in close proximity to Modesto, but neither sighting was confirmed.
sentences.zh: 这两个地点都离莫德斯托很近，但都没有得到证实。

sentences.en: Jens Sund and others close to the missing women were subjected to polygraph testing and ruled out as suspects.
sentences.zh: 延斯·桑德和其他与失踪女性关系密切的人接受了测谎测试，并被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Jens was struggling to remain positive and often broke down.
sentences.zh: 延斯努力保持乐观，但经常崩溃。

sentences.en: He prepared himself for the worst, telling his other children that they'd been lucky so far, but their lives were about to get harder.
sentences.zh: 他做好了最坏的打算，告诉他的其他孩子，他们到目前为止还算幸运，但他们的生活即将变得更加艰难。

sentences.en: Carol was Jens' high school sweetheart.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔是延斯的高中恋人。

sentences.en: The couple had created their perfect family, starting with the birth of Julie in 1983, followed by the adoption of three more children.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇建立了一个完美的家庭，从1983年朱莉的出生开始，随后又领养了三个孩子。

sentences.en: Carol was described as a super mum, and Jens wasn't sure how they'd cope without her.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔被描述为一位超级妈妈，延斯不知道没有她他们该如何生活。

sentences.en: The son's grief was shared by the Peloso family.
sentences.zh: 佩洛索一家也和这位儿子的悲痛感同身受。

sentences.en: Sylvina's mother, Raquel, had arrived in California from Argentina.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娜的母亲拉奎尔已经从阿根廷抵达加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: She was later joined by her husband, Sylvina's father, Jose.
sentences.zh: 后来她的丈夫，也就是西尔维娜的父亲何塞也加入了她的行列。

sentences.en: Raquel initially thought that her daughter had been in an accident.
sentences.zh: 拉奎尔起初认为她的女儿是出了事故。

sentences.en: She told the press,
sentences.zh: 她告诉媒体：

sentences.en: The only thing I was afraid of was earthquakes in California.
sentences.zh: 我唯一害怕的就是加利福尼亚的地震。

sentences.en: I trust the Sund family.
sentences.zh: 我相信桑德一家。

sentences.en: I considered that they were going to take good care of my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们会好好照顾我的女儿。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that they did.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们确实做到了。

sentences.en: According to Raquel, Sylvina had never expressed concern about her time in America.
sentences.zh: 据拉奎尔说，西尔维娜从未表达过对她在美期间的担忧。

sentences.en: It was her daughter's dream to go to the States.
sentences.zh: 去美国是她女儿的梦想。

sentences.en: When Carol Sund made the trip to Argentina in the 70s, it was during an intense time of political turmoil.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗尔·桑德在70年代去阿根廷旅行时，那正是政治动荡的激烈时期。

sentences.en: Raquel said,
sentences.zh: 拉奎尔说：

sentences.en: As the end of February neared, 50 FBI agents were working the case.
sentences.zh: 随着二月底的临近，50名联邦调查局探员正在处理此案。

sentences.en: 7,000 miles of terrain had been covered, and 900 tips generating 233 leads had been followed up.
sentences.zh: 搜寻范围已覆盖7000英里，900条线索产生了233条调查方向。

sentences.en: But authorities had yet to find any concrete evidence that a crime had even occurred.
sentences.zh: 但当局尚未找到任何确凿证据证明发生了犯罪。

sentences.en: Special Agent Maddox stated that while the FBI held hopes of a miracle, They now believed that Carol and Julie Sund and Sylvina Peloso were no longer alive.
sentences.zh: 特别探员马多克斯表示，虽然联邦调查局仍怀有奇迹的希望，但他们现在认为卡罗尔、朱莉·桑德和西尔维娜·佩洛索已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: By March, investigators were growing frustrated.
sentences.zh: 到了三月，调查人员感到越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: It was unusual for them to work so hard on a case without making a single breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何突破的情况下如此努力地处理一个案件，对他们来说是不寻常的。

sentences.en: Television program America's Most Wanted did a feature on the disappearance.
sentences.zh: 电视节目《全美通缉令》对这起失踪案进行了专题报道。

sentences.en: This garnered national attention for the case, but no further breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 这引起了全国对该案的关注，但没有取得进一步的突破。

sentences.en: Victimology, the study of victim behaviour, was used to determine how the women might have reacted to various scenarios.
sentences.zh: 受害者学，即对受害者行为的研究，被用来确定这些女性在各种情况下可能做出的反应。

sentences.en: Child abduction experts devised suspect profiles, and background checks were carried out on those who raised suspicion.
sentences.zh: 儿童绑架专家制定了嫌疑人画像，并对那些引起怀疑的人进行了背景调查。

sentences.en: Persons of interest were interviewed and polygraphed.
sentences.zh: 相关人员接受了采访和测谎。

sentences.en: But, they were all eliminated from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 但是，他们都被从调查中排除了。

sentences.en: That month, the FBI set about interviewing employees of the Cedar Lodge, and two suspects emerged.
sentences.zh: 那个月，联邦调查局开始采访雪松旅馆的员工，两名嫌疑人浮出水面。

sentences.en: One was a staff member who had given Carol her room key.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是曾给卡罗尔房卡的员工。

sentences.en: As it turned out, he was a registered sex offender.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他是一名注册性犯罪者。

sentences.en: He had also visited Modesto two days before Carol's wallet insert was found there.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗尔的钱包内页在那里被发现的两天前，他也曾去过莫德斯托。

sentences.en: The other suspect was a janitor named Billy Joe Strange.
sentences.zh: 另一名嫌疑人是一名名叫比利·乔·斯特兰奇的清洁工。

sentences.en: His history included domestic violence and battery.
sentences.zh: 他的前科包括家庭暴力和殴打。

sentences.en: When investigators sought Strange for questioning in relation to the Sund-Peloso case, he attempted to run.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员因桑德-佩洛索案寻找斯特兰奇问话时，他试图逃跑。

sentences.en: He was promptly captured, and claimed that he'd fled because he didn't want to be hassled by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他很快被抓获，并声称他逃跑是因为不想被联邦调查局骚扰。

sentences.en: It was determined that Strange didn't have an alibi for the night the trio were last seen.
sentences.zh: 经确定，斯特兰奇在三人最后一次露面的当晚没有不在场证明。

sentences.en: He professed his innocence, but a polygraph test indicated that he wasn't being truthful.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己是无辜的，但测谎测试显示他在撒谎。

sentences.en: An associate claimed that Strange had talked about killing and raping women before hiding their bodies.
sentences.zh: 一名同伙声称，斯特兰奇曾谈论过杀害和强奸女性，然后藏匿她们的尸体。

sentences.en: Strange was interviewed several times, but there was no evidence linking him to the disappearance, and he was free to go.
sentences.zh: 斯特兰奇接受了多次讯问，但没有证据将他与失踪案联系起来，他被释放了。

sentences.en: Locals who knew Strange were more inclined to believe that an outsider was responsible.
sentences.zh: 认识斯特兰奇的当地人更倾向于认为是一个外来者所为。

sentences.en: In contrast, Strange's former mother-in-law described him as a violent man with a strong temper.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，斯特兰奇的前岳母形容他是一个脾气暴躁的暴力男人。

sentences.en: She was suspicious of him from the moment news of the Sund-Peloso disappearance hit.
sentences.zh: 从桑德-佩洛索失踪的消息传出那一刻起，她就对他产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: Days later, investigators searched Billy Joe Strange's cabin in El Portal, near the Cedar Lodge, and found cannabis.
sentences.zh: 几天后，调查人员搜查了比利·乔·斯特兰奇在雪松旅馆附近的埃尔波塔尔的小屋，发现了大麻。

sentences.en: This breached Strange's parole conditions, which forbade him from using illicit drugs.
sentences.zh: 这违反了斯特兰奇的假释条件，该条件禁止他使用非法药物。

sentences.en: He was placed under arrest, and a search was carried out on his janitorial shed at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 他被逮捕，并对他在酒店的清洁工具棚进行了搜查。

sentences.en: Inside, a waterlogged laundry bag was found that appeared to have a bloodstain.
sentences.zh: 在里面，发现了一个被水浸透的洗衣袋，上面似乎有血迹。

sentences.en: Strange's girlfriend's car was also seized, and another blood-like stain was spotted on the carpet.
sentences.zh: 斯特兰奇女友的车也被扣押，地毯上发现了另一处类似血迹的污渍。

sentences.en: Analysis of the substance concluded it was ruSt.
sentences.zh: 对该物质的分析结论是它是铁锈。

sentences.en: As the one-month anniversary of Carol, Julie, and Sylvina's disappearance approached, a vigil for hope was held in Modesto.
sentences.zh: 随着卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜失踪一个月的纪念日临近，莫德斯托举行了一场希望守夜活动。

sentences.en: It highlighted multiple missing person cases, with many attendees carrying photos of loved ones whose whereabouts were unknown.
sentences.zh: 活动突出了多起失踪人口案件，许多参加者带着下落不明的亲人的照片。

sentences.en: Yen Sund didn't appear at the event, citing emotional exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 延斯·桑德因情绪疲惫没有出席活动。

sentences.en: A poem, written by his 13-year-old daughter, Regina, was read out to the 600-strong crowd.
sentences.zh: 他13岁的女儿雷吉娜写的一首诗被读给600名观众听。

sentences.en: It said,
sentences.zh: 诗中写道：

sentences.en: At a time when I need my mother's touch most, all I see of her are pictures nailed to a poSt.
sentences.zh: 在我最需要母亲抚摸的时候，我看到的只有钉在柱子上的照片。

sentences.en: When it is time for bed, I rock myself to sleep.
sentences.zh: 当该睡觉时，我摇晃着自己入睡。

sentences.en: I try to stay strong because I know that's what you'd want your baby to be.
sentences.zh: 我努力保持坚强，因为我知道那是你希望你的宝贝成为的样子。

sentences.en: But mummy, I don't want you to leave me.
sentences.zh: 但是妈妈，我不想让你离开我。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Thursday, March 18, retired carpenter Jim Powers was out target shooting near Dodge Ridge Ski Resort.
sentences.zh: 3月18日星期四下午，退休木匠吉姆·鲍尔斯在道奇岭滑雪场附近进行打靶射击。

sentences.en: Located approximately 110 miles south of the Cedar Lodge, the area in Tuolumne County is part of the Stanislaus National ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 该地区位于雪松旅馆以南约110英里处，属于图奥勒米县的斯坦尼斯劳斯国家森林的一部分。

sentences.en: The forest spans almost 900,000 acres of woodland, rivers, and streaMs.
sentences.zh: 森林覆盖了近90万英亩的林地、河流和溪流。

sentences.en: As Jim shuffled down a slope in some rugged terrain off Highway 180, something caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 当吉姆在180号公路旁崎岖的地形中沿斜坡走下时，有什么东西引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: There were a few slivers of red paint and a license plate on the ground.
sentences.zh: 地上有几片红色的油漆碎片和一个车牌。

sentences.en: Jim Powers eased deeper into the dense forest and came across the wreckage of a burned-out car.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·鲍尔斯深入茂密的森林，发现了那辆烧毁汽车的残骸。

sentences.en: The intense fire had stripped the paint off of all but one of the door handles.
sentences.zh: 猛烈的大火剥去了除一个门把手外所有部位的油漆。

sentences.en: All that remained was the rusting metal shell, with the interior soggy from recent rain.
sentences.zh: 剩下的只有生锈的金属外壳，内部因最近的雨水而变得潮湿。

sentences.en: Jim examined the license plate.
sentences.zh: 吉姆检查了车牌。

sentences.en: It read, 4BMV025.
sentences.zh: 上面写着4BMV025。

sentences.en: His adrenaline surged.
sentences.zh: 他的肾上腺素飙升。

sentences.en: He recognised it from the missing person flyers that had been circulating the local community.
sentences.zh: 他从当地社区流传的失踪人员传单上认出了它。

sentences.en: With his stomach in knots, Jim took it back to his car and drove home to contact the authorities.
sentences.zh: 吉姆心急如焚，把它带回车里，开车回家联系当局。

sentences.en: FBI agents descended on the forest immediately.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局探员立即涌入森林。

sentences.en: With the help of the Highway Patrol, they identified the destroyed vehicle as the Pontiac rented by Carol Sund.
sentences.zh: 在公路巡警的帮助下，他们确认这辆被毁的车辆就是卡罗尔·桑德租用的那辆庞蒂亚克。

sentences.en: It had been missed during aerial searches due to the density of the forest ceiling above it.
sentences.zh: 由于森林顶部的茂密，它在空中搜寻中被遗漏了。

sentences.en: As a result of his discovery, Jim Powers was granted the $50,000 reward from Carol's parents.
sentences.zh: 由于他的发现，吉姆·鲍尔斯获得了卡罗尔父母提供的5万美元悬赏金。

sentences.en: They called Jim their hero, as without the crucial find, the investigation would still be at a standstill.
sentences.zh: 他们称吉姆为英雄，因为如果没有这个关键的发现，调查仍将陷入僵局。

sentences.en: Jim said he would use the money to send his children to college.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说他会用这笔钱送他的孩子们上大学。

sentences.en: Arson investigators confirmed that the Pontiac's interior had been doused with gasoline before being deliberately torched.
sentences.zh: 纵火调查人员证实，庞蒂亚克的内部在被蓄意焚烧前被泼了汽油。

sentences.en: The heat from the flames had been so extreme that tree branches 25 feet above were scorched.
sentences.zh: 火焰产生的热量非常极端，以至于25英尺高的树枝都被烧焦了。

sentences.en: This would have likely caused a forest fire had the surrounding woods not been covered with ice and snow.
sentences.zh: 如果周围的树林没有被冰雪覆盖，这很可能会引发森林大火。

sentences.en: Finding a burned out item wasn't unusual for the area.
sentences.zh: 在该地区发现烧毁的物品并不罕见。

sentences.en: It was known to be a dumping ground for old appliances and other junk, which locals often set on fire.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，这里是倾倒旧电器和其他垃圾的地方，当地人经常把它们烧掉。

sentences.en: However, a local man who lived across the road from where the car was found had noted a peculiar odour two to three weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 然而，一位住在发现汽车地点对面路上的当地人曾在两三周前注意到一种奇怪的气味。

sentences.en: A woman's hiking boot and an intact can of Coca-Cola were found near the burned out car.
sentences.zh: 在烧毁的汽车附近发现了一只女式登山靴和一个完好的可口可乐罐。

sentences.en: As darkness fell, a full forensic examination of the scene was postponed until morning.
sentences.zh: 随着夜幕降临，对现场的全面法医检查被推迟到第二天早上。

sentences.en: Special Agent James Maddock told reporters that although there were no bodies found in the car,
sentences.zh: 特别探员詹姆斯·马多克告诉记者，虽然车内没有发现尸体，

sentences.en: they now had incontrovertible evidence that Carol, Julie and Sylvina had fallen victim to a violent crime.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在有无可辩驳的证据表明卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜成了暴力犯罪的受害者。

sentences.en: With her daughter and companions still missing, Raquel Peloso told the press,
sentences.zh: 由于女儿和同伴仍然失踪，拉奎尔·佩洛索告诉媒体：

sentences.en: I just hope they are kept somewhere and alive.
sentences.zh: 我只希望她们被关在某个地方，还活着。

sentences.en: The following morning of Friday March 19, the Pontiac's trunk was opened for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第二天3月19日星期五早上，庞蒂亚克的后备箱第一次被打开。

sentences.en: Inside were the remains of two badly burnt bodies.
sentences.zh: 里面有两具严重烧焦的尸体残骸。

sentences.en: It couldn't be ascertained whether they were male or female, but investigators were certain they had found either Carol, Julie or Sylvina.
sentences.zh: 无法确定它们是男性还是女性，但调查人员确信他们找到了卡罗尔、朱莉或西尔维娜中的两人。

sentences.en: It would take time to compare the remains with DNA and dental records before they would know for sure.
sentences.zh: 在确定身份之前，还需要时间将遗骸与DNA和牙科记录进行比对。

sentences.en: The damage to both bodies was so immense that a cause of death could not be established.
sentences.zh: 两具尸体的损毁程度都非常严重，无法确定死因。

sentences.en: Due to the wintry conditions, a perimeter search of the forest surrounding the Pontiac was difficult.
sentences.zh: 由于冬季条件，对庞蒂亚克周围森林的周边搜寻很困难。

sentences.en: Recent snowfall had also masked any footprints or other evidence that might have been left by those responsible.
sentences.zh: 最近的降雪也掩盖了肇事者可能留下的任何脚印或其他证据。

sentences.en: The bad weather led to a temporary suspension of the search.
sentences.zh: 恶劣的天气导致搜寻工作暂时中止。

sentences.en: The Sund and Peloso families were in mutual shock.
sentences.zh: 桑德和佩洛索两家人都陷入了共同的震惊之中。

sentences.en: Carol's mother told the media,
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的母亲告诉媒体：

sentences.en: Special Agent James Maddick expressed his hope that the third victim would be found alive.
sentences.zh: 特别探员詹姆斯·马多克表示希望第三名受害者能被活着找到。

sentences.en: The FBI faced criticism in the aftermath of the discovery.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局在发现尸体后面临批评。

sentences.en: The day after the women were last seen at the Cedar Lodge, they were allegedly spotted at a Tuolumne County gas station and at a gift shop.
sentences.zh: 在这些女性最后一次在雪松旅馆露面的第二天，据称有人在图奥勒米县的一个加油站和一家礼品店看到了她们。

sentences.en: Both locations weren't far from where the Pontiac was found.
sentences.zh: 这两个地点距离发现庞蒂亚克的地方都不远。

sentences.en: These sightings were reported to the tip line, but were never followed up.
sentences.zh: 这些目击报告被上报到了举报热线，但从未得到跟进。

sentences.en: The FBI defended this decision, with Special Agent Maddick stating that all the reported sightings they received couldn't logically be true.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局为这一决定进行了辩护，特别探员马多克表示，他们收到的所有目击报告在逻辑上不可能都是真实的。

sentences.en: The Tuolumne County community consisted mostly of retirees and small business owners.
sentences.zh: 图奥勒米县社区主要由退休人员和小企业主组成。

sentences.en: But a number of methamphetamine labs were also known to operate in the area.
sentences.zh: 但众所周知，该地区也有一些甲基苯丙胺实验室在运作。

sentences.en: The possibility that the crime was drug-related was just one of many scenarios considered.
sentences.zh: 犯罪与毒品有关的可能性只是考虑的众多方案之一。

sentences.en: Special Agent Maddick thought the women had been carjacked.
sentences.zh: 特别探员马多克认为这些女性是被劫车的。

sentences.en: He believed multiple perpetrators were involved, as it would have been difficult for one individual to wrangle all three women.
sentences.zh: 他认为涉及多名肇事者，因为一个人很难同时控制住三名女性。

sentences.en: The perpetrators were likely local to the area, as the location where the vehicle was destroyed wasn't a place outsiders would be familiar with.
sentences.zh: 肇事者很可能是当地人，因为销毁车辆的地点不是外地人会熟悉的地方。

sentences.en: Within 24 hours of the vehicle being recovered, approximately 300 calls were placed to the FBI tip line.
sentences.zh: 在车辆被找回后的24小时内，大约有300个电话打到了联邦调查局的举报热线。

sentences.en: Although the FBI would remain involved to some degree, the case was officially handed over to the Tuolumne County Sheriff's Department.
sentences.zh: 虽然联邦调查局仍将在一定程度上参与，但案件已正式移交给图奥勒米县治安官部门。

sentences.en: On Sunday March 21, a change in the weather allowed the search of the scorched forest to recommence.
sentences.zh: 3月21日星期日，天气的变化使得对烧焦森林的搜寻得以重新开始。

sentences.en: Not far from the dumping site, investigators came across several items of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 在距离倾倒地点不远的地方，调查人员发现了几个感兴趣的物品。

sentences.en: The keys to the Pontiac, a handheld compact CD player, and an undamaged roll of camera film.
sentences.zh: 庞蒂亚克的钥匙、一个手持式紧凑型CD播放器，以及一卷未损坏的相机胶卷。

sentences.en: The film was developed, revealing images of Carol, Julie, and Sylvina taken between February 13 and 15.
sentences.zh: 胶卷被冲洗出来，显示了卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜在2月13日至15日之间拍摄的照片。

sentences.en: The pictures depicted the trio's time in Yosemite, posing in front of spectacular landscapes, playing in the snow, and ice skating on a frozen lake.
sentences.zh: 照片描绘了这三人在这段时间在优胜美地的时光，她们在壮丽的风景前摆姿势，在雪中玩耍，并在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

sentences.en: One photo was taken the night before the women disappeared, presumably by Julie.
sentences.zh: 其中一张照片是在她们失踪的前一天晚上拍的，大概是朱莉拍的。

sentences.en: It captured Carol and Sylvina in their hotel room at Cedar Lodge, sitting on the edge of their beds.
sentences.zh: 照片捕捉到了卡罗尔和西尔维娜在雪松旅馆的房间里，坐在床边。

sentences.en: It was a candid shot, with Carol in the midst of rummaging through her handbag.
sentences.zh: 这是一张抓拍的照片，当时卡萝尔正忙着翻找她的手提包。

sentences.en: Yet, both women were acknowledging the camera with a smile.
sentences.zh: 然而，两位女性都微笑着看向镜头。

sentences.en: Seven of the photos recovered from the camera roll were given to the Sund family, with Carol's mother telling the press,
sentences.zh: 从相机胶卷中找回的七张照片被交给了桑德一家，卡萝尔的母亲对媒体表示：

sentences.en: The rest of the photographs were taken into evidence by the FBI, who refused to comment on what they showed.
sentences.zh: 其余的照片被联邦调查局作为证据收缴，他们拒绝透露照片的内容。

sentences.en: On March 21, a white cross and a vase of wildflowers were placed at the Pontiac dumping site by members of Carol, Julie, and Sylvina's families.
sentences.zh: 3月21日，卡萝尔、朱莉和西尔维娜的家人们在庞蒂亚克汽车的倾倒地点放置了一个白色十字架和一瓶野花。

sentences.en: Carol's mother told the press,
sentences.zh: 卡萝尔的母亲告诉媒体：

sentences.en: Carol was such a caring person.
sentences.zh: 卡萝尔是一个非常有爱心的人。

sentences.en: I just can't imagine the fear when she knew these girls were in trouble and couldn't do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法想象，当她知道这些女孩陷入困境却无能为力时，内心该有多么恐惧。

sentences.en: The next day, dental records confirmed that one of the two bodies found in the vehicle belonged to Carol Sund.
sentences.zh: 第二天，牙科记录证实，在车内发现的两具尸体中，其中一具属于卡萝尔·桑德。

sentences.en: Further DNA testing was required to verify the identity of the second victim.
sentences.zh: 需要进一步的DNA检测来确认第二名受害者的身份。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Wednesday March 24, a letter arrived at the Modesto Police Department.
sentences.zh: 两天后的3月24日星期三，莫德斯托警察局收到了一封信。

sentences.en: Its envelope was postmarked March 16 and should have been delivered much earlier, but a mix-up at the post office delayed its arrival.
sentences.zh: 信封上的邮戳日期是3月16日，本应更早送达，但邮局的失误延误了它的投递。

sentences.en: Inside was a handwritten note in black ink on white-lined paper.
sentences.zh: 信里是一张写在白色横线纸上的手写便条，用的是黑色墨水。

sentences.en: The writing was untidy and was accompanied by a crudely drawn map.
sentences.zh: 字迹潦草，并附有一张粗略绘制的地图。

sentences.en: It directed police to the Vista Point lookout at Dom Pedro Reservoir in Tuolumne County.
sentences.zh: 它指引警方前往图奥勒米县唐佩德罗水库的维斯塔角观景点。

sentences.en: A line was marked to represent Highway 120.
sentences.zh: 地图上画了一条线代表120号公路。

sentences.en: Above the map were the words, We had fun with this one.
sentences.zh: 地图上方写着：“我们这次玩得很开心。”

sentences.en: Analysis of the note failed to uncover anything significant.
sentences.zh: 对便条的分析未能发现任何重要线索。

sentences.en: DNA found on the stamp and the envelope's seal was run through the criminal database, to no result.
sentences.zh: 在邮票和信封封口处发现的DNA被输入犯罪数据库，但没有结果。

sentences.en: Investigators followed the map the next day, arriving at the Dom Pedro Reservoir on the western edge of Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 调查人员第二天沿着地图指引，抵达了位于优胜美地国家公园西缘的唐佩德罗水库。

sentences.en: It was around halfway between where Carol, Julie and Sylvina were last seen and the location where their burned-out vehicle was found.
sentences.zh: 这里大约位于卡萝尔、朱莉和西尔维娜最后一次露面的地点，与她们烧毁的车辆被发现的地点之间的一半路程处。

sentences.en: Located just off Highway 120,
sentences.zh: 它位于120号公路旁，

sentences.en: Vista Point provided a scenic stop-off for visitors wanting to soak in the views of the expansive waterfront and its bordering tree-lined hillsides.
sentences.zh: 维斯塔角为想要欣赏广阔水域及其周边树木繁茂山坡景色的游客提供了一个风景优美的停靠点。

sentences.en: It didn't contain much beyond a parking lot and a small hiking trail to the top of the hill.
sentences.zh: 除了一个停车场和一条通往山顶的小型徒步小径外，这里并没有太多东西。

sentences.en: There were no direct access points to the water.
sentences.zh: 没有直接通往水边的通道。

sentences.en: A cadaver dog was taken down the steep, grassy hill that led to the reservoir.
sentences.zh: 搜尸犬被带下通往水库的陡峭草坡。

sentences.en: Within minutes, the canine made a discovery.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，搜尸犬就有了发现。

sentences.en: Lying partly covered by a poison oak bush was the body of 15-year-old Julie Sund.
sentences.zh: 在毒橡树丛下半掩着15岁朱莉·桑德的尸体。

sentences.en: Her throat had been cut, her ankles were duct-taped together, and her arms had been folded neatly across her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她的喉咙被割开，脚踝被胶带捆在一起，双臂整齐地交叉在胸前。

sentences.en: Upon the identification of both Carol and Julie Sund's remains, it was determined that the second body found in the Pontiac's trunk was that of 16-year-old Sylvina Peloso.
sentences.zh: 在确认了卡萝尔和朱莉·桑德的遗体后，确定在庞蒂亚克汽车后备箱中发现的第二具尸体是16岁的西尔维娜·佩洛索。

sentences.en: Dark pink fibres were found on Julie's body.
sentences.zh: 在朱莉的尸体上发现了深粉色的纤维。

sentences.en: This prompted FBI agents to revisit the Cedar Lodge in search of Manchester that the fibres might have originated from.
sentences.zh: 这促使联邦调查局特工重新走访雪松旅馆，寻找这些纤维可能来源的曼彻斯特织物。

sentences.en: A maintenance worker took agents through each room, where they stripped bedding and removed it from the premises to undergo analysis.
sentences.zh: 一名维修工带着特工检查了每个房间，他们拆下床上用品并将其移出场所进行分析。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案件档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持案件档案继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The triple homicide would come to be known as the Yosemite Sightseer Murders.
sentences.zh: 这起三尸命案后来被称为“优胜美地游客谋杀案”。

sentences.en: Yen Sund had no mercy for those responsible and hoped they would face capital punishment.
sentences.zh: 延·桑德对肇事者毫无怜悯，并希望他们能面临死刑。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：
